**Lessons (last evening's review)**
- Retests fill almost always but lose money: 31 trades average −4.0% vs +2.6% for the rest; now off the list (holding)
- Pullbacks reach T1 most often: 21 of 25 bought hit T1, none of 15 closed lost money (+87.6%) (holding)
- Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners: 14 of 20 would have hit T1 (holding)
- Very high trigger volume (over 2.5×) often means no fill: 7 of 12 filled; fills dip −10.2% (holding)
- The top-10 cut leaves winners behind: near misses hit T1 72% (81 of 113) vs 66% for real picks (new)
